result.summary: Scope test: APPLIES (tenant-data path) -- diff adds Letflow.Engine.ExecutionError.append_multi/3 and Letflow.Engine.set_instance_error/2, both writing EXECUTION_ERROR events and instance_projections.error_detail (schema-isolated per Decision 0003/0006), plus rewires Engine.complete_task/3's merge/transition steps to route into them. Verdicts: INV-1 APPLIES/PASS -- (a) every query/write against instance_projections uses repo.one/repo.update with prefix: prefix (fetch_and_lock_projection, update_projection_to_error), and EventStore.append/2 is called with prefix: prefix; set_instance_error/2 validates the prefix via TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 before proceeding. (b) no new migration in this diff -- instance_projections.error_detail/status:error already exist from prior REQ-023/043 migrations, confirmed via `git diff main...HEAD --stat -- priv/repo/migrations/` (empty). (c) tenant_id is never caller-supplied here: event_attrs built in append_execution_error_event/2 carries no :tenant_id key at all, and EventStore.append/2 (unmodified by this diff) derives tenant_id solely from opts[:prefix] via TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 and hard-rejects any attrs-supplied :tenant_id (reject_tenant_id/1) -- confirmed by reading lib/letflow/event_store.ex. INV-2 NOT-APPLICABLE (S4 not started, no API response shaping in this diff). INV-3 NOT-APPLICABLE (S5 not started). INV-4 APPLIES/PASS -- grep for System.get_env and hardcoded-secret heuristic pattern against both changed files: no hits; the persisted variable-map snapshot (AC1) is tenant-authored process/business data flowing through the same schema-scoped path as every other tenant record, not platform secret material (API keys/DB URLs/signing keys) that INV-4 targets -- no secret-resolution code touched. INV-5 NOT-APPLICABLE (S4 not started, no lookup-by-ID endpoint in this diff). INV-6 APPLIES/PASS -- this handoff itself is the required proof-of-scoping artifact. INV-7 APPLIES/PASS -- grep for Repo.query against both changed files: zero hits; all access goes through Ecto.Query composition (where/lock/prefix). INV-8 APPLIES/PASS -- grep for bare `{:ok, x} = ...` assignment pattern against both files: all hits are `case`-clause pattern matches (safe, exhaustive via other clauses), not unguarded assignments; new error paths (VariableMerge :rejected, Transition {:error, {:no_matching_edge, ...}}) are explicitly routed into typed {:execution_error, error_args} tuples rather than raising, and the ExecutionError module's own Multi.run/2 steps all return {:ok,_}/{:error,_} tagged tuples. No BLOCKER findings on any applicable invariant.
